text:
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy embed-service v2.1.3 -> eu-west (10% traffic)
alex: watching slo dash, heads-up if p95 climbs :eyes:
maria: oncall here, i'll keep an eye. linking dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/slo/embed-service?env=eu-west
oncall-bot: ALERT: embed-service eu-west p95 latency breached 220ms (slo: p95 < 200ms). 5xx rate 0.9% -> triggered
alex: ok saw it, looks like routing is tripping on new kv-cache behavior. can we pin traffic back to stable while we triage?
jamie: recommend pin to stable v2.1.2 at 90% and keep canary at 10% until root cause. quick fix minimizes user impact.
kai: will add a temporary route-level circuit-breaker and reroute. running command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --service embed-service --region eu-west --pin-version v2.1.2 --pin-pct 90
redwoodctl config set embed-service --circuit-breaker 500ms --threshold 0.8
```
jamie: i ran the pin command, API returned 200. routing change propagated.
oncall-bot: NOTE: traffic split changed: stable v2.1.2 90% | v2.1.3 canary 10% (propagated in 12s)
alex: can someone run a quick smoke sample against /embed endpoint? just 50 reqs with typical prompt lengths
maria: doing smoke now — sending sample
maria: smoke results: p95 back to 145ms, 5xx at 0.1% — looks stable :thumbsup:
kai: starting deeper triage on kv-cache hotpath, grabbing logs and trace for slow tail
jamie: i'll hold the rest of the rollout for the change window. no further traffic shifts until triage complete.
alex: also create a short blurb for release notes and incident log so support gets context. example:
```
- Rollout: embed-service v2.1.3 (canary 10%)
- Action: Pinned to v2.1.2 (90%) after p95 spike; triage ongoing for kv-cache regression
- Impact: transient p95 latency increase for EU users; recovered after pin
- Follow-up: root cause investigation + patch rollout
```
maria: added to the release-notes channel and flagged SRE for postmortem. tagging @sre-lead for visibility
oncall-bot: RESOLVED: alert cleared — p95 back under threshold for 3 consecutive samples
alex: thanks team. let's keep canary at 10% until kai posts root-cause. if spike recurs we'll rollback fully.
jamie: agreed. i'll update the deploy ticket and mark pause in the change window schedule.
kai: initial trace shows kv cache stampede on long prefixes; testing a mitigation patch now, will report in ~30m
maria: leaving this thread open, will post final status and attach logs to the incident ticket  — also pinging support to prep customer comms
alex: :white_check_mark: good recovery. closing active triage after root cause verified.
